deadline.value: The department's PhD deadline for full consideration is December 1, 2026 (Fall entry only); the graduate-studies program page lists January 7.
deadline.quote: Application deadlines for Fall are as follows: PhD: December 1 | must be received by the above deadlines in order to be eligible for full consideration

gre_general.value: GRE scores are not required, but good scores may be submitted and can help.
gre_general.quote: No, we do not require them. However, if you have taken them and done well, you may submit them, and it may help your application.

gre_subject.value: The GRE Mathematics subject test is not required, but a good score may be submitted and can help.
gre_subject.quote: No, we do not require them. However, if you have taken them and done well, you may submit them, and it may help your application.

toefl_min.value: TOEFL 4.5 on the new 1-6 scale, with 5 in writing and speaking.

ielts_min.value: IELTS Academic 7.0 overall with at least 6.5 in writing and speaking.

supervisor.value: PhD offers need at least one willing supervisor; name one to three potential supervisors on the application.
supervisor.quote: For PhD applicants, we cannot offer admission unless there is at least one willing supervisor in our department.

funding.value: The department gives full financial support (TA work plus scholarships) to all admitted graduate students.
funding.quote: We offer full financial support to all admitted graduate students, and part of the package is made up of scholarships.

entry_route.value: A master's with 78% is the listed route, but the department accepts and prefers direct PhD entry from a strong bachelor's.
entry_route.quote: We can accept students into the PhD program who have not completed a master's degree. In fact, we prefer to admit students as PhD students when possible.

notes: Waterloo also runs separate PhDs in Applied Mathematics and in Combinatorics and Optimization; this record covers Pure Mathematics.
